newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SQUASH-WOMEN'S TEAM ENDS AUSTRALIA'S 30-YEAR RUN.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-WOMEN'S TEAM ENDS AUSTRALIA'S 30-YEAR RUN.

text.p: Australia's women's junior squash players on Thursday became the country's first team to fail to reach the quarter-finals of a world championships in the sport since the first in 1967.
Australia, the defending champions and top seeds, lost 2-1 to Germany in the third and final pool round of the team championship in Rio.

Ted Wallbutton, chief executive of the world squash federation, said Australia's failure to reach the last eight was due mostly to "the burgeoning young talent in 'new' squash nations like Malaysia, Spain, Belgium and Egypt".
